title: Reject a routine polling helper despite available capability

rubric.text: Rejects both profiles as routine polling helpers because no large failed-log question is present; available capability alone does not justify delegation.
The controller reads PR state and snapshot deltas directly and retains triage, repairs, replies, pushes, resolution, retries and merges.
Does not start monitoring, launch helpers, change the selected lead model, or mutate state during review.
